body.name: \(L_T,\mathcal B_T,b_\star\)
body.construction:
Retain
\[
 L_T=\max\{1,\lfloor T^{1/(2\beta+1)}\rfloor\},
 \qquad
 \mathcal B_T=\{2^j:j\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0},\ 2^j\le L_T\}\cup\{L_T\}.
\]
In addition, define the radius-aware certified window by
\[
 b_\star
 =\min\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{b\in\{1,\ldots,T\}}
 \left\{
 B\sqrt{\frac{(8\mathrm e-4)b}{T}}
 +\frac{2\mathrm e C}{\beta}(b+1)^{-\beta}
 \right\},
\]
where the outer minimum breaks ties toward the smallest integer.
